behaviour: Pure styled-range model: normalise, apply a style, diff and shift on edits, sanitise, clamp, map ranges onto wrapped lines and lay out runs.
rules: 1. No DOM, React or measurement imports; the only imports are `import type { ExcalidrawTextElement, TextAlign, TextStyleRange } from "./types";`. Every function returns new arrays and never mutates its inputs.
2. A colour value counts as present only when it is a non-empty string; output range objects have the keys start and end, plus color and highlight only when present (never a key holding undefined).

3. normalizeStyleRanges: clamp start and end into [0, textLength], drop ranges with start >= end or with no colour present; resolve overlaps with a sorted boundary sweep where, on each elementary segment, ranges later in the input override each property they define; drop segments with no property; merge neighbours where a.end === b.start and color and highlight are equal; return sorted by start.

4. applyTextStyle: clamp [start, end) into [0, textLength] and return the normalised input unchanged when empty; otherwise keep each normalised range's parts outside the span as they are, and on its part inside the span set each style key whose value is a string and delete each key whose value is null (undefined keys untouched); fill uncovered gaps inside the span with a new range holding the style's string values (none when it has no string value); return the normalised result.

5. diffText: p = length of the common prefix; s = length of the common suffix, capped at min(prev.length, next.length) - p; returns null when the strings are equal, else { from: p, to: prev.length - s, insertLength: next.length - s - p }.

6. shiftStyleRanges maps each range with delta = insertLength - (to - from): start' = start < from ? start : start >= to ? start + delta : from + insertLength; end' = end <= from ? end : end >= to ? end + delta : from; so text inserted strictly inside a range takes its style and text inserted at a range boundary does not; then normalise against nextTextLength (callers may pass Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY).

7. getStyledLines: split `text` on "
" and walk a pointer p through originalText; before every line after the first, step over one "
" if originalText[p] is "
", otherwise skip whitespace other than "
" until originalText.startsWith(line, p); a line found at p covers [p, p + line.length) and is cut into runs at range boundaries, each run { text, start, color, highlight } taking the covering range's values or null; a line not found at p becomes one unstyled run and p advances by its length; an empty line gives [].

8. getStyledRunPositions: total = sum of widths; lineLeft = 0 for left, (boxWidth - total) / 2 for center, boxWidth - total for right; left to right x[i] = lineLeft + sum(widths[0..i-1]); when rtl x[i] = lineLeft + total - sum(widths[0..i]).

9. getUniformRangeStyle returns the property's value when every offset of the clamped [start, end) is covered by normalised ranges with that same present value, else null (also null for an empty span).

10. sanitizeStyleRanges: non-array gives null; keep only entries that are objects with Number.isInteger start and end; keep color/highlight only when non-empty strings; drop entries left with no colour; normalise against textLength; an empty result gives null.
11. getStyleRangesClampUpdate returns {} when the element has no ranges or normalizeStyleRanges(ranges, textLength) is equal per areStyleRangesEqual, else { styleRanges: <normalised> }.
12. areStyleRangesEqual compares length and each range's start, end, color and highlight in order.

behaviour: Canvas draws styled text as per-line runs with highlight rectangles, and the per-element canvas cache regenerates when the ranges change.
rules: 1. Imports: `import { getLineHeightInPx, getLineWidth } from "./textMeasurements";` and `import { getStyledLines, getStyledRunPositions } from "./textStyleRanges";`.

ExcalidrawElementWithCanvas gains `styleRanges: ExcalidrawTextElement["styleRanges"] | null;`; generateElementCanvas returns `styleRanges: isTextElement(element) ? element.styleRanges ?? null : null`; generateElementWithCanvas also regenerates when `prevElementWithCanvas.styleRanges` differs (by reference) from that same expression for the current element.

Otherwise: set `context.textAlign = "left"`; for each line index of getStyledLines(element.originalText, element.text, element.styleRanges) measure each run with getLineWidth(run.text, getFontString(element), renderConfig.renderEnvironment), get x positions with getStyledRunPositions(widths, element.textAlign, element.width, rtl); first fill every highlighted run's rectangle (x, index * lineHeightPx, width, lineHeightPx) with applyDarkModeFilter(run.highlight, dark), then fillText each run at (x, index * lineHeightPx + verticalOffset) with fillStyle applyDarkModeFilter(run.color ?? element.strokeColor, dark), where dark is `renderConfig.theme === THEME.DARK`.
